display_long_description:
Welcome to the most chaotic supermarket in virtual reality.
In Supermarket Chaos VR, you're not just managing a store — you're living it. Physically grab products and hurl them onto shelves, scan items at the register, count out change by hand, and pry open delivery crates with your own fingers. Every action is hands-on, every shift is unpredictable, and every customer is a new problem waiting to happen.
Run your store your way
Start small and grow your supermarket into a retail empire. Set your own prices, design your store layout, customize your space, and expand into new sections as your business takes off.
The customers won't make it easy
NPCs shop, complain, and cause trouble — and some of them will straight-up steal from you. Spot the shoplifters before they walk out the door, or watch your profits disappear.
You can't do it alone
Hire staff to keep operations running smoothly. Manage your team, delegate tasks, and build the crew that keeps your supermarket from falling apart.
VR the way it should be
No button menus for stocking shelves. No floating UI for checkout. Everything in Supermarket Chaos VR is physical — grab it, scan it, throw it, hand it over. Your hands do the work.
Key features

Physical shelf stocking with hand grab
Hands-on cashier system — scan items and give change by hand
Shoplifter detection and theft mechanic
Staff hiring and management
Store expansion and upgrades
Pricing strategy and inventory management
Full store customization and layout control
